entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I have a return. I think. I'm just so confused by all this. I have a helmet I ordered a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Alex Chen. The order number is... umm... VF789012. I'm sorry, I'm just not very good with this stuff. The box is still unopened, if that helps.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order for the AeroSafe Helmet here. It looks like it was delivered about 69 days ago. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
A preference, I guess? The color on the website looked different. It just wasn't what I was expecting and I got overwhelmed and put it aside. I really don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Alex. I'm here to help. So the issue is just with the color, not the fit or any safety features of the helmet itself, correct?
Right, I never even took it out. The box unopened is sitting right here. I just want to send it back. I hope it's not too late.

Let me just check the policy for you. One moment... Okay, I've confirmed it. Since this is a standard helmet and you're within the 10-day return window, we can absolutely process this for you. And because the box is unopened, its safety integrity is maintained, which is great.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome, Alex. It's no problem at all. I am emailing you a pre-paid return label now. Just print it out, attach it to the original shipping box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Does that sound good?
Yes, that sounds perfect! You've been a great help, Diana. Thank you.
Happy to assist, Alex. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Nope, that was it. Have a good day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and ride safely.
